keydisplay.py
```python
#!/usr/bin/python
import pygame
from pygame.locals import *
pygame.init()

screen = pygame.display.set_mode((480, 320))

font = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", 12)

while 1:
    for e in pygame.event.get():
        if e.type == KEYDOWN:
            print e
            screen.fill((0,0,0))
            screen.blit(font.render(e.unicode, False, (255,255,255)), (0,0))

        pygame.display.flip()
```
